newsitem.title: USA: Universal sees FY 97 EPS top estimates.
newsitem.headline: Universal sees FY 97 EPS top estimates.

text.p: Universal Corp said Wednesday it expected to post more than $100 million in earnings, or $2.85 a share, in the year ended June 30.
Universal said the expected earnings to top analysts' estimates ranging from $88 million ($2.50 a share) to $97.6 million ($2.78 a share).
A May 1 First Call consensus estimate of five brokers put Universal's earnings at $2.74 a share.
Chief executive Henry Harrell attributed the better-than-expected results to improved fundamentals in the tabacco market and benefits from the restructuring the company started in 1993.
Seperately, Universal said Wednesday it bought tabacco processing plants in Poland and Tanzania for an undisclosed amount.

In Poland, the company bought Wytwornia Wyrobow Tytoniowych SA from German Reemtsma Cigarettenfabriken Gmbh. Universal said the plant in the Grudziadz region employs about 200 people and will buy and process tabacco for the Polish market.

Universal also said it bought Tanzania's only leaf processing facility as part of the government's ongoing privatization process. The company said it anticipates further investments to modernize and expand the plant in Morogoro.
Universal's stock traded at 34-3/16, up 6/16 Wednesday afternoon.
